integrity: Two explicit complete adaptive trees, a self-contained checker, and recorded verification output are included. Source literature supplies the previously known static VC dimension and common-neighbor geometry.
scientific_limitations: The exact formula covers \(3\le k\le n-3\). It concerns open neighborhoods. Lower bounds rely on explicit finite decision-tree witnesses; upper bounds and rank embeddings are proved mathematically. Comprehensive historical priority and independent validation are not established.
title: Exact online shattering dimension of interior-rank Johnson graphs
